metadata.title: OT Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for defining, classifying, and governing operational technology systems and safety constraints.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and safety‑critical environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern establishing scope, safety assumptions, and operating constraints of OT systems.

props.name: safety-principle
props.remarks: In OT environments, safety takes precedence over availability and confidentiality.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: OT Core provides context for understanding attacker behavior affecting cyber‑physical systems.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Relevant ATT&CK tactics include Impact and Defense Evasion in OT/ICS environments.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: OT Core aligns defensive architecture with cyber‑physical system protection techniques.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Foundational defensive techniques for OT asset governance and safety assurance.

metadata.remarks: OT Core defines what constitutes an OT system, how safety constrains security controls, and which baseline operational assumptions apply. Control realization is expressed at the capability level using IEC 62443‑aligned requirements, with ATT&CK and D3FEND providing threat and defense context.

components.title: OT System Identification
components.description: Identification and inventory of operational technology assets, controllers, and control networks.

implemented-requirements.remarks: OT assets and systems are identified and maintained in an authoritative inventory.

components.title: Safety Criticality Classification
components.description: Classification of OT systems based on potential safety, environmental, and operational impact.

implemented-requirements.remarks: OT systems are classified according to safety impact and risk to people, environment, and operations.

components.title: Baseline Operational Assumptions
components.description: Definition of deterministic, safety, and reliability assumptions governing OT system operation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Operational and safety assumptions are documented and used to constrain security control selection.
